capabilityBindings.truthBoundary: Network owns the forwarding source and kernel/consumer acceptance, not Workstation installation or Runtime Job truth.
Workstation owns installed and loaded Unit effects, not Network consumer success.
Network owner-native task reconciles forwarding and reads provider/kernel state; Runtime execution is not domain completion.

stages.responsibility: Bind accepted shared-egress forward Unit/helper bytes to an exact source and native non-restart reload contract.
Materialize Network-forward source bytes and load the systemd Unit exposing ExecReload without restarting physical Gluetun.
Run the owner-native reload and observe exact forwarding rule, namespace, provider process and carrier continuity.
Independently read an affected consumer path without equating service active or composition gate success to domain acceptance.

gateRequirements.assumption: The accepted forward source is an exact current source cut, not an Agent prose assertion.
gateRequirements.guarantee: Installed and loaded native Unit are bound to accepted Network source and declare a native reload path.
gateRequirements.supportScope: Network shared-egress Forward source-to-installed-and-loaded systemd boundary only

gateRequirements.assumption: The loaded native Unit exposes ExecReload and its physical dependencies are sampled before reconciliation.
gateRequirements.guarantee: Network can use native reload and inspect kernel/provider continuity without assuming job success implies consumer outcome.
gateRequirements.supportScope: Network shared-egress loaded Unit-to-native kernel/provider reload boundary only

nonClaims: This circuit is a task-local architecture contract, not a provider control plane.
Verifiers and Gate results must come from natural owners and actual observations.
Mechanical composition closure never establishes Network consumer acceptance or grants execution authority.
